card.name: Possessives before family nouns; label cross-references
card.fires_on: Possessive words (his, her, their, an apostrophe) just before a family or life noun such as wife, lives, love affair or offspring. Also the opening bracket or space in "[see Use in Specific Populations (8.1)]" cross-references.

modes.label: Possessive before relationship noun
modes.description: his, her, their or 's right before a noun about a spouse, family, friend or life events in biographical or pregnancy-related text.
modes.example: Burroughs has said that the death of<< his>> wife gave him a literary vocation.
